profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Agile Software Engineer talented at contributing to multi-team development projects. Collaborative designer of exceptionally useful solutions and perfectly customized products. Knowledgeable in programming environments ranging from application development tools to source code management. Excels as a customer-focused software professional with superior communication skills and expertise in various technical platforms. Understanding and meeting both client and employer needs to develop highly functional, robust and easy-to-use applications. While quickly learning and mastering new technologies while working in both team and self-directed settings. Enthusiastic team player ready to contribute to enterprise success.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Review and integrate all application requirements, including functional, security, integration, performance, quality and operational requirements 
- Review and integrate the technical architecture requirements 
- Provide input into final decisions regarding hardware, network products, system software and security 
- Worked with a team to upgrade, update and improve controls and processes in a timely matter on government contracts
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Agile Methodologies · Agile Application Development · Compass

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Practiced extreme devops, including daily paired programming.
- Sustained an Air Force application used for air operations planning and monitoring 
- Maintained associated typescript react web application built on material UI and communicating with Java Spring server endpoints.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure software development projects are delivered on-time and within scope
- Utilize Agile methodologies to ensure software development projects are delivered on-time, within scope, and to the satisfaction of stakeholders.
- Troubleshoot and debug issues to ensure software meets quality standards.
- Design, develop, and maintain the core of the client's connected vehicle audio streaming software platform using Java and AWS-based microservices architecture.
- Write well-designed, testable, efficient code that meets quality standards.
- Troubleshoot and debug issues to ensure software meets quality standards.
- Adhere to SDLC best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Networking · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Troubleshooting · Computer Science · Data Structures · Teamwork · REST APIs · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving · SQL · Web Services · Spring Boot · API Development · Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Provides proactive approach to resolving defects, improving processes, and reducing accumulation of technical debt.
- Coordinates with other engineers to evaluate and improve software and hardware interfaces.
- Gather and define customer requirements to develop clear specifications for project plans.
- Coordinated with other engineers to evaluate and improve software and hardware interfaces.
- Designs, develops, codes, and tests complex technical solutions while collaborating with senior engineers.
- Analyze propose technical solutions based on customer requirements, budget and product goal.
- Serves as active mentor junior engineers.
- Discuss project progress with customers, while collecting feedback on different stages and directly addressing concerns.
- Collaborate effectively with members of software development team and personnel in other departments.
- Serves as a strong facilitator coupled with exceptional communication skills (verbal,written,illustration).
- Provides support software engineering projects in Agile work environment.
- Reviewed project specifications and designed technology solutions that met or exceeded performance expectations.
- Design, develop, code, and test complex technical solutions while collaborating with senior engineers.
- Revise, modularize and update old code bases to modern development standards, reducing operating costs and improving functionality.
- Communicates technical development stages and providing design support to businesses and other stakeholders encouraging participation for on-time execution.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Networking · Scrum · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Troubleshooting · Computer Science · Data Structures · Jira · Teamwork · REST APIs · Analytical Skills · Problem Solving · SQL · Web Services · API Development · Git

positions.title: Engineer Technician
positions.description:
- Tested concrete to make sure air levels were up to par before pouring
- Calculated theoretical and experimental measurements of various road maintaining materials
- Checked the accuracy of bridge abutments, piers, center lines, and elevations to insure the plans were properly executed

positions.title: Undergraduate Research
positions.description:
- Participated in regular meetings to discuss aspects of research and experiments.
- Developed top-level skills in collaboration, interpersonal communication and writing through hands-on work and training.
- Cooperated with others in team-based environment to identify points from data analysis.
- Participated in continuous improvement by generating suggestions, engaging in problem-solving activities to support teamwork.
- Conducted laboratory experiments on causes of Freak Waves using MATLAB after thorough planning and research.
- Recorded data in university database using provided systems.
- Assessed data using scientific methods while following important specifications.
- Used critical thinking to break down problems, evaluate solutions and make decisions.
- Identified issues, analyzed information and provided solutions to problems.

positions.title: Parking Management Service
positions.description:
- Handled and cared for numerous vehicles 
- Maintained vehicles and brought them out upon request
- Worked with a team of parkers in carrying out orders in a timely matter

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
- Handled calls concerning various issues
- Operated numerous computer applications
- Evaluated problems and assisted customers to solve them

Activities
NSBE
LAMP
